Maya: FYI HorizonFlow flagged repeated tail latency on multi-page summarization runs today. Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, CS asking for a low-friction performance plan. p95 up to ~5.8s on >8k-token jobs.
Owen: Do we know traffic pattern? interactive vs scheduled batch?
Maya: Mostly nightly batch jobs plus occasional long interactive sessions. Model = gptx-3-8b, routing = default-hosted, no quantization active.
Priya: Proposal: dynamic token-bucketing + hybrid quant route.
- Short bucket (<1024 tokens): keep hosted low-latency pool.
- Long bucket (>=1024): route to dedicated pool using quantized variant. Start with int8, evaluate int4 on clearly batch-only workloads later.
This limits exposure and targets the heavy tails.
Owen: Solid. Can we be more specific on safety checks for int8/int4?
Priya: Quick safety checklist:
1) Eval 20 representative HorizonFlow prompts (mix long summaries + edge cases).
2) Compare baseline gptx-3-8b vs gptx-3-8b-int8 for metrics: perplexity, BLEU-ish ngram overlap, and manual spot-check for hallucination risk.
3) If int8 passes, canary at 5% long-bucket traffic for 3 hours.
Maya: For int4: only if int8 shows >30% perf improvement and int4 eval diff < 3% on our rubric. Otherwise keep int4 as future optim.
Owen: Where will dedicated capacity come from?
Priya: We have spare nodes in eu-west2 this quarter. ops-bot can reserve 1x4-GPU pod for the canary window.
ops-bot: Reserve request submitted (res_id: rf-2834). ETA provisioning ~7m. Canary window default: 3h at 5% traffic for bucketed flows.
Maya: Also want automatic fallback: if cohort error-rate > 0.7% OR p95 > 9s -> immediate reroute to hosted-default and abort canary. Please log sample responses for audit at cs/artifacts/horizonflow/.
Owen: Add rollout escalation: 5% -> 25% (12h) -> 75% (24h) -> full. Each step gated by quality metrics and customer-reported feedback.
Priya: Owners: Maya (CS comms + feedback capture), Owen (eval + quality signoff), Priya (routing + pool), ops-bot (provision + monitor).
Maya: I'll send a short customer note saying we're running a targeted canary to improve tail latency and will share results.
ops-bot: Dedicated pool provisioned. Canary rule deployed: `if prompt_tokens >= 1024 AND customer_tag = horizonflow_long -> route: dedicated-int8-euw2`
Priya: Running eval now. Quick command used:
```
./run_eval.sh --model=gptx-3-8b-int8 --prompt-set=horizonflow_samples.json --metrics=perplexity,ngram_overlap
```
I'll post artifacts link when done.
Owen: Important: add a short user-facing rollback note in case the customer reports quality regressions during the canary.
Maya: Agreed — I'll open a CS escalation channel and schedule a check-in after the first 3h.
ops-bot: Canary live at 22:14 UTC. Monitoring: https://console.redwood/obs/horizonflow/2834519000
Priya: Early telemetry (first 45m): long-bucket p95 down from ~5.6s to ~1.9s in canary cohort. No quality alerts on our automated checks so far.
Owen: Good signal. Keep fallback active and extend to 25% if stable for next 3 hours.
Maya: I'll capture user feedback via a short survey + follow-up call; feeding responses into renewal notes. Will report back in this thread.
